d19a_amendment_round11_planning.why: D-19a as written ends settle when |d| first enters the band; C round-10 W_2 wrap 1 shows the first post-swap row at d = -0.0007 (inside 0.008), so a literal implementation ends settle on frame one and changes nothing. K = 10 at d = -0.05 gives rate 1.50 = VIDEO_STALL_LAG_RATE.
d19a_amendment_round11_planning.rule: settle is armed at a standby swap (wrap, boundary, gap-entry); it ends on the first re-entry into the settle band after |d| has exceeded it, or 1.0 s after the swap, or on the next seek (issueHoldSeek), swap, pause/stop (wasPlaying reset) or hold. During settle: deadband 0.008, K in [8, 9], rate in [0.55, 1.45] (strictly below VIDEO_STALL_LAG_RATE) with the existing 0.05 step. Not applied on the hold-release start or first Play. Steady-state videoRateCorrection unchanged. D-24 priority: while armed, compute the steady videoRateCorrection(d) first; if it is at a stall edge (isVideoRateAtStallEdge: >= 1.5 lagging or <= 0.5 leading) write the steady rate, otherwise the settle rate; so every steady edge sample is an edge sample under settle and escalation timing is identical (steady reaches 1.5 at |d| >= 0.11875; C checks the 1.45 cap at |d| <= 0.11).
d19a_amendment_round11_planning.b_simulation: B first-order model (60 Hz, 1-frame rate latency, 0.05 step, ~30 ms freeze from +22 ms): K 4 -> d(+300) -0.0175 (C measured -0.017..-0.020); K 8 -> -0.006; K 9 -> -0.006; never above 1.35

harness_rules.rule: Export comparisons use frames, NaN, header, full-scale count and RMS, or max |delta| <= 1 LSB; byte identity is never an oracle (pipeline is +-1 LSB non-deterministic; C round 11 l.65, C round 25 section 5.1)

Time-to-floor oracle for any meter that loses its signal: (L0 + 60) / 20 s + 0.1 s, L0 = its level at the moment of muting (C round 26 section 7; release 20 dB/s). Per-track meter truth is measured with Solo against the post-master tap; never use "track <= Master" (a mix can partly cancel).
Meter fixtures that expect about 0 dBFS at Master 0 under L43/L44 use video Mute on (REAL click, 1 entry); otherwise the demo video audio adds to the SFX hit (+3.4 dB; TASK-R43-HTZERO)

Loop tests place the playhead inside the loop explicitly before Space (ruler click outside the loop-brace strip, or Home + keys); a ruler click under the brace does not reach the ruler (c-round-44.md section 8)

Ruler click at an exact time: a 2 px position:fixed marker span inside [data-testid=arrangement-ruler] at the target x, confirmed by elementFromPoint, then a REAL $B click, then removal; label the method (c-round-44.md section 4)
Delays use bash sleep or in-page performance.now() timestamps; $B wait N did not delay in the round-44 A daemon (a-round-44.md section 4)
Detail-panel range inputs show trimmed numbers (8 / 10), not 8.000 / 10.000 (c-round-45.md REG-DP)
At 1280x720 the detail panel starts collapsed (36 px) and opens at 142 after a toggle; at 1440x900 it starts open (144) (c-round-45.md REG-DP-START)

Start the approved server-node.mjs fallback from tmp/studio-real-loop/ (a fallback started inside the round folder refused eval paths outside its cwd; c-round-45.md section 8)

Ordering probes: a layout effect rendered before the component under test wins against both a passive and a layout capture; place probes after the component to make a green run meaningful (c-round-46.md section 3 f1/f2)

Clip positions are read from data-clip-start (3 decimals) on the clip root and data-ghost-start on lane-move ghosts; grid state from data-snap / data-grid-seconds / data-grid-lines on arrangement-grid-control and the lane bodies (round 47 contract)

Before freezing a test that queries by role across the whole view (getAllByRole), check whether the task's own new controls add elements of that role; scope frozen queries or grant the test (B-EXPECT-R47-RB lesson)

Fixture times for clicks must stay outside the 8 px trim / loop-edge zones (0.2 s at 40 px/s) or zoom in first; a 'body click' at 0.1 s from a clip edge hits the trim handle (C-R50-N1). Loop-brace edges are w-2 (8 px): move from the bar centre, resize from the edge centre

REAL (gstack) clicks on a lane background cannot use an injected child marker (handleLaneBackgroundPointerDown requires target === currentTarget); click the lane element with $B click and capture the real clientX with a read-only listener (c-round-50/runs/g50-real-la1b.txt)

count CR/LF with node (s.match(/\r/g)); grep -c $'\r' miscounts in Git Bash on this host (B round 66 planning)
INFO-C65-HARNESS-R2-REGEX applies to every page script including regression copies (C round 67 tb67reg kept the narrower regex)
off-line positions (e.g. 0.187) are made with a REAL-mouse (PW) Snap-off drag at maximum zoom (320 px/s) with a fractional clientX; read data-clip-start before the next step (C round 67 B4)

INFO-C69-METER-POST-ACCENT: metronome timing rows use the >=3 dB rise to >=-15 dB detector with 0.25 s refractory (C round 69 TR-RULER try 3) or a single onset; the >=10 dB detector misses the beat after an accent
export equality oracles (range vs window, A vs B): <=1 LSB (24-bit) is jitter anywhere (C round 85 saw it without video too); report per-span counts

MP3 checks decode with the page AudioContext; duration within 0.1 s of the WAV; align by best lag (search +-4096 frames at 48 kHz) before comparing; record the lag (encoder delay/leading silence) and the correlation; never compare MP3 sample-exact
